example_prompt: Ask Cartflox which of my aggregators (PayDunya or CinetPay) should carry a 5,000 XOF payment from a Senegal number.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method vocabulary of the routing engine.

phone.description: Customer number; the operator is inferred from its prefix when `paymentMethod` is absent.

items.description: Aggregator key as known by the routing engine.

preferredProvider.description: Aggregator key as known by the routing engine.

oneOf.description: Payment method vocabulary of the routing engine.

method.description: Payment method vocabulary of the routing engine.

error_schema.description: Error body. `code` is present on transfer endpoints.

gotchas: Requires a secret key. It returns a routing decision (provider, ordered alternates, confidence); it is not a payment.
country, amount (a number) and a non-empty availableProviders array are required (400 otherwise); provider keys use the routing vocabulary (paydunya, cinetpay, pawapay...).
When paymentMethod is absent and phone is present, the operator is inferred from the number prefix (detectedOperator, or null).
The routing method vocabulary uses hyphens (orange-money, free-money, t-money) and differs from the transfer operator vocabulary (orange_money, free_money, tmoney).

The docs disagree on the routing response: the OpenAPI types rankedProviders as {provider, score} objects, availableMethods items as {method, providers} and routing as {provider, reason, alternates, confidence}, while the Multi-gateway orchestration guide shows rankedProviders as plain strings, availableMethods items with code and name, and routing as {provider, method, reason: "best_success_rate"}. This spec follows the OpenAPI and stays draft until a live call settles it: parse these fields defensively.
Rate limit: 120 per minute per IP; beyond it the API answers 429.

Errors are an HTTP 4xx/5xx status with a JSON body { "error": "<message>" }. Transfer endpoints add a machine-readable code, and so do some other refusals (code test_mode on payment links, rate_limited on webhook resends). A 401 says Missing API key or Invalid API Key.

evidence.source_reference: OpenAPI 2026-09-19, paths./v1/route.post (operationId routePayment) and info.description. Passages quoted from https://cartflox.com/docs/llms-full.txt (same snapshot date): ""rankedProviders": [ "paydunya", "cinetpay" ]" | ""availableMethods": [ { "code": "wave", "name": "Wave", "providers": ["paydunya", "cinetpay"] } ]" | ""routing": { "provider": "paydunya", "method": "orange", "reason": "best_success_rate" }"
spans: Returns the best aggregator for a given context (country, amount, currency, operator),
with ordered fallbacks and a confidence score.
Aggregator key as known by the routing engine.
`phone` is present, the operator is inferred from the number prefix.
Payment method vocabulary of the routing engine.
Limits apply per minute. Beyond them the response is `429`
Errors are reported by the HTTP status code and a JSON body `{ "error": "<message>" }`.
API key missing or invalid: `Missing API key` or `Invalid API Key`
